title: The merge tool reads a job cap written as an expression, so the merge-lock floor is not too low
why: merge.py base_job_caps skips a cap such as `timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.cap }}`. Measured on q_max: the matrix maximum is 42, so the floor should be 47, but the tool reads 40 (lane qmax-merge-deadline, session_013NEJKz6tCDukV1yMoiPQ83, 03:30 CST Nov 8; coordinator 03:30 CST).
note: Fix: resolve a matrix expression to the maximum of its values; when it cannot be resolved, read it as unknown and fail closed to the largest cap found. Red case first: a matrix fixture whose largest cap is an expression gives too low a floor today; control: a plain numeric cap reads as today. Related done step c34 (the merge tool waits for CI to finish). q_max #1037 closes unmerged (premise gone); its step qmax-merge-deadline lives in q_max's records, not this roadmap.
